metaDescription: A short, calm summary of Paul Fleury's Weekathon: seven free, open-source launches in seven days, with audio in your language.
title: The Weekathon, in simple words
lead: I am Paul Fleury, and I live in Lisbon, Portugal. From 9 to 15 November 2026, I am launching one new project every day on Product Hunt, a website where people discover new products.

sections.heading: Seven days, seven products
sections.text: Every morning, a new product goes live. All seven are free and open source: anyone can use them, read their code and improve them. I made them with the help of artificial intelligence.

sections.heading: Why this week
sections.text: It is the week of Web Summit, a big technology conference in Lisbon. I dedicate the Weekathon to Web Summit and to everyone who loves to build things. No launch team, no campaign for votes. Just useful tools, shared in the open.

sections.heading: Your feedback counts
sections.text: After each launch, I read the bug reports and ideas. I fix what matters first, then keep improving the projects in public.

sections.heading: What comes next
sections.text: From 16 to 18 November, three more free extras. On 22 November, a small Sunday warm-up. On 24 November, Enki, a non-profit project for artificial intelligence that people can own. On 1 December, my main business, Openline. Later, on 15 December, Cup of News, a news app.

sections.heading: Meet me
sections.text: I will be at Web Summit in Lisbon from 9 to 12 November. Come and say hello, or send me a message on X or LinkedIn.
